content.thinking: I'm realizing this nvim config is managed through Nix home-manager, so everything in ~/.config/nvim is read-only and symlinked from the nix store. I need to track down the actual Nix flake configuration in the user's dotfiles that's generating this setup, and I'm noticing the plugins directory only has a couple of symlinked files.

input.command:
set -x
readlink -f /nix/store/3vzi6lg8kbxxddr16yi7b5s6f2v452jc-home-manager-files/.config/nvim/lua/plugins/_lazyvim_nix_default.lua 2>&1
echo "---search common config dirs---"
for d in ~/nixos-config ~/dotfiles ~/.config/home-manager ~/nix-config ~/nixconfig ~/.dotfiles /etc/nixos; do
  [ -e "$d" ] && echo "FOUND: $d"
done
echo "---find flake.nix owned by user---"
find / -maxdepth 6 -name flake.nix -not -path '/nix/store/*' 2>/dev/null
echo "---home-manager generation source---"
readlink -f /nix/var/nix/profiles/per-user/$USER/home-manager 2>/dev/null
which home-manager 2>/dev/null
